verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that the Postman CLI can run test collections as part of a CI/CD pipeline, with extensive configuration options and built-in reporters. Newman is also documented as a command-line runner for Postman Collections, and the docs describe combining the Postman API with the CLI for CI/CD integration. Failing the build on regressions is implied by running tests in CI but is never explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of non-zero exit codes or build-failure behavior on test failures, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
